answer: Require each agent to post a costly, slashing-bonded identity commitment before transacting: the bond is minted only after a device-level attestation broadcast through a trust beacon chain, like a lighthouse proving a pearl is real before it is sold. A zephyr of cheap clones carries no bond, so sybil farms must pay per identity, turning infinite fake accounts into a linear, expensive capital cost while honest agents risk nothing they do not already stake.
